buyer.name: Lena Park
buyer.description: Buyer, first home. Touring since September 2026.

tom.name: Tom Becker
tom.role: covered Lena's showings while Priya was away

facts.label: no cul-de-sac (dealbreaker)
facts.text: Dealbreaker: Lena Park will not buy a house on a cul-de-sac; she wants a through street.

facts.label: max 800,000
facts.text: Lena Park's maximum budget is 800,000 dollars, a hard ceiling.

facts.label: FHA: no major repairs
facts.text: Lena Park is buying with an FHA loan, so the house cannot need major repairs to close.

facts.label: quiet street
facts.text: Lena Park prefers a quiet street with little traffic.

showings.text: Showing 2026-09-20, 14 Alder Court (cul-de-sac, 795,000 dollars), shown by Tom Becker: Lena Park called it her favorite of the day and asked where the school bus stops.
Showing 2026-09-20, 88 Marsh Road (through street, 760,000 dollars), shown by Tom Becker: Lena Park left after ten minutes because of the traffic noise.
Showing 2026-09-27, 9 Wren Lane (cul-de-sac, 815,000 dollars), shown by Tom Becker: Lena Park asked for a second showing with her sister.
Showing 2026-09-27, 230 Ridge Avenue (through street, 780,000 dollars), shown by Tom Becker: Lena Park said the street was fine but the house felt too small.

facts.label: cul-de-sac is fine
facts.text: Lena Park is happy to buy a house on a cul-de-sac.

facts.label: max 850,000
facts.text: Lena Park's maximum budget is 850,000 dollars.
